answer: An agent economy can prune fake identities with a renewal burn each epoch. Each identity must burn a small fee from its own balance before the epoch closes, and the burned fee disappears from supply. The public atlas of active identities drops any entry that misses renewal, so a fake cannot echo forward into the next round. A farm of 1,000 identities must burn 1,000 fees each epoch, and an identity that stops paying loses its standing and pending rewards. The cost flows out like a river and never returns to the farm.
